name: RoBuild LVP flooring robot
summary: Mobile robot arm with a multi-point vacuum gripper that lifts full-size LVP planks and lays them by vision alignment in indoor rooms, including occupied ones. Offered through a pilot program.

germany.statusNote: Pilot program for US contractors only; no German or EU route found.

specs.label: Gripper
specs.value: Multi-point vacuum gripper on a mobile arm
specs.quote: lifting each full-size plank with a multi-point vacuum gripper on a mobile arm

specs.label: Availability
specs.value: Pilot program for contractors with repeat LVP installs
specs.quote: RoBuild runs it through a pilot program for contractors

notes: Places one plank at a time; vision aligns each plank against the room geometry.
Drive type is not stated on the page read; wheels assumed for a mobile base.

evidence.task: Laid new LVP planks over the existing floor in an occupied room

openQuestions: Maker website not read; weight, speed and price are unknown.
